title: Parameter chart rings, origin localizations, completions and substitutions
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,r\ge0$, and $u:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to R$. In $S=R[t_0,\ldots,t_{r-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], define $v=(u_0,\ldots,u_{n-1},t_0,\ldots,t_{r-1})$. Let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n+r-1\}$ and let $a$ be an optional pivot in this index set. For a uniform definition extend the labels by a last dummy label $*$, extend $v$ by $v_*=0$, embed $J$ in the enlarged labels as $\widetilde J$, and put $b=a$ if $a$ is defined and $b=*$ otherwise. Put $L=\widetilde J\setminus\{b\}$. Define the quotient chart algebra $C=S[Y_l:l\in L]/(v_l-v_bY_l:l\in L)$ and the canonical map $\alpha:S\to C$. This is the polynomial quotient construction of [def-trf-parameter-blowup-chart-ring] over $S$, with these extended labels. For each original label $i$, define $w_i=\overline{Y_i}$ if its embedded label belongs to $L$, and $w_i=\alpha(v_i)$ otherwise. Define the origin ideal $q=(w_i:0\le i<n+r)\subseteq C$. When $q$ is prime define $B=C_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], its structural map $R\to S\xrightarrow{\alpha}C\to B$, its maximal-ideal completion $\widehat B$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], the ideal $\mathfrak m_B\widehat B$, and the canonical map $C\to B\to\widehat B$. Finally, for any commutative ring $F$, define the substituted variable $V_i\in F[[W_0,\ldots,W_{n+r-1}]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] by $V_i=W_{a'}W_i$ if $i\in J$ and $a\ne\mathrm{some}(i)$, and by $V_i=W_i$ otherwise, where $a'=a$ when defined and $a'=i$ otherwise. These are definitions for every $J,a$; the coordinate-blowup applications use $J=\varnothing,a=\mathrm{none}$ or $a\in J$. No primality, regularity, completion comparison or identification with a blowup is asserted.
